readReason: Import the text file you select
writeReason: Export this note to the location you choose
deniedBody: Allow file access in the app’s permissions, then try again.
readFailure: Your existing notes are kept. Select the file again.
writeFailure: Your note is kept. Choose another file name or try again.
invalidBody: Choose a UTF-8 text file up to 512 bytes.
upgrade: Update the system to use this feature.
hint: Use Import in the home page’s top bar to add a text file. While editing, use Export in the top bar to save the current text as a file.
title: Notes
emptyBody: Create a note to capture an idea.
aboutBody: Capture tasks, plans, and ideas. Tap a note to read it, and scroll through your notes and text.
aboutStorage: Choose Save after creating or editing a note. Notes are stored on this device and work offline. Manage the app and its data in Settings → Apps.
keepEditor: Your text is still in the editor. Try again.
readLater: Notes couldn’t be loaded. Reopen the app and try again.
readCorrupt: The notes data couldn’t be read. The original records have been kept.
overLimit: This note exceeds the saved-text limit.
keepOriginal: Your original note is kept. Try again.
